### 5. content.config.ts

**Collection Schemas:**

**1. Articles Collection** (`articles`)
- **Loader:** MDX files from `./src/content/articles`
- **Schema Fields:**
  - Basic: `title`, `excerpt`, `draft`, `publishedAt`, `updatedAt`, `coverImage`, `author`, `category`
  - Organization: `hubs[]`, `topics[]`, `relatedArticles[]`
  - Automotive-specific:
    - `vehicles[]` - Vehicle slugs
    - `vehicleTypes[]` - Enum: `car`, `truck`, `suv`, `minivan`, `hybrid`, `electric`
    - `articleType` - Enum: `troubleshooting`, `how-to`, `buyer-guide`, `comparison`, `cost-guide`, `maintenance-schedule`
    - `difficulty` - Enum: `beginner`, `intermediate`, `advanced`
    - `timeCostSkill` - Object: `time`, `diyCost`, `shopCost`, `skill`, `notes`
    - `safetyLevel` - Enum: `low`, `medium`, `high` (default: `low`)
    - `partsNeeded[]` - For affiliate linking
    - `toolsNeeded[]` - For affiliate linking
    - `obdCodes[]` - OBD-II diagnostic codes
    - `maintenanceInterval` - String
  - SEO: `seo` object (title, description, canonicalUrl, noIndex)
  - Monetization: `adsEnabled` (default: `true`), `affiliateEnabled` (default: `true`)
  - Safety: `stopHere[]` - Safety callouts for high-risk content

**2. Hubs Collection** (`hubs`)
- **Loader:** MDX files from `./src/content/hubs`
- **Schema Fields:**
  - `title`, `description`, `icon`
  - `featuredArticles[]`
  - `order` (default: `0`)
  - `parentHub` - For sub-hubs
  - `featured` - Object with sections: `troubleshooting[]`, `howTos[]`, `buyerGuides[]`, `costGuides[]`, `comparisons[]`, `subHubs[]`
  - `seo` object

**3. Authors Collection** (`authors`)
- **Loader:** YAML files from `./src/data/authors`
- **Schema Fields:** `name`, `bio`, `avatar`, `credentials`, `specialties[]`

**4. Categories Collection** (`categories`)
- **Loader:** YAML files from `./src/data/categories`
- **Schema Fields:** `title`, `description`, `icon`, `parent`

**5. Topics Collection** (`topics`)
- **Loader:** YAML files from `./src/data/topics`
- **Schema Fields:** `title`, `description`

**6. Vehicles Collection** (`vehicles`)
- **Loader:** YAML files from `./src/data/vehicles`
- **Schema Fields:**
  - `make`, `model`, `yearRange`, `slug`
  - `engines[]`
  - `type` - Vehicle type enum
  - `commonIssues[]`
  - `maintenanceNotes`

**Reusable Schema Fragments:**
- `seoSchema` - SEO metadata object
- `timeCostSkillSchema` - Time, cost, and skill level object
- `difficultySchema` - Difficulty enum
- `safetyLevelSchema` - Safety level enum
- `vehicleTypeSchema` - Vehicle type enum

### 6. README.md

**Project Overview:**
- Automotive DIY and maintenance website
- Built with Astro 5.0 + MDX
- Tagline: "Fix it yourself. Save hundreds."

**Content Coverage:**
- Fix & Troubleshoot
- Maintain & Prevent
- Buy & Compare
- Learn
- Seasonal

**Tech Stack:**
- Framework: Astro 5.0
- Content: MDX with custom automotive components
- Styling: Tailwind CSS with custom design system
- TypeScript: Full type safety
- Deployment: Vercel

**Architecture:**
- Mirrors "The Home Field Guide" architecture, adapted for automotive content
- Custom MDX components for automotive-specific content (diagnostics, safety, tools, parts, etc.)

**Content Strategy:**
- Monetization: Affiliate revenue (primary), display ads (secondary), digital products (tertiary)
- SEO: Make/model-specific guides, symptom-first troubleshooting, buyer guides

**Safety & Legal:**
- Safety-first approach
- Clear "when to call a professional" guidance
- Proper disclaimers and legal pages

Includes 23 articles, custom MDX components for diagnostics and safety, and a content structure organized by hubs, categories, and topics. Configured for SEO and monetization (affiliate links and ads).
